Casting Floodpits Drowner at flash speed during combat or on the opponent's turn would be more flexible - it could tap down a blocker or an attacker, and holds up the option to react. High Noon would severely limit their ability to chain spells and trigger prowess multiple times. However, Voice of Victory's 'opponents can't cast spells during your turn' effect is also powerful, and having two copies provides redundancy. The choice is debatable but High Noon seems like a stronger lock piece in this matchup.
